name: Alexander Zverev
intro: Alexander Zverev is a super-tall star from Germany. His friends call him Sascha. He is the number 1 seed, the top ranking badge here.
story: Sascha comes from a tennis family. His mom, dad, and big brother Mischa were all pros. His dad has coached him since he was little. In 2026 he finally won the French Open. That is a Grand Slam, one of the four biggest tournaments.

funFacts.text: He is 6 feet 6 inches tall. That is really, really tall!
He travels with a little grey poodle named Lovik. Lovik even had his own tournament pass!
He speaks three languages: German, Russian, and English.
He loves basketball. His favorite player ever is Dwyane Wade.
He met Roger Federer at age five and got his autograph. Years later he beat Federer in a real match!
He won Olympic gold in Tokyo in 2021.
In his free time he plays golf and video games.

watchFor: Watch his sky-high ball toss, then a serve so fast it is a blur.
